symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two interchanged address chunks.
symbols.quote: it swaps two disjoint address fields, chunks, of $u$ bits each (the chunk width) in an array of volume $V$ (stored bits) in $O(Vu^\tau)$ time on fixed tapes

symbols.name: array volume
symbols.meaning: The number of bits stored in the array.
symbols.quote: it swaps two disjoint address fields, chunks, of $u$ bits each (the chunk width) in an array of volume $V$ (stored bits) in $O(Vu^\tau)$ time on fixed tapes

symbols.name: prefix
symbols.meaning: The part of an address before the first chunk.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$ with prefix $p$, chunks $h$ and $d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: first chunk
symbols.meaning: The first of the two address chunks being interchanged.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$ with prefix $p$, chunks $h$ and $d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: gap
symbols.meaning: The part of an address between the two chunks.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$ with prefix $p$, chunks $h$ and $d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: second chunk
symbols.meaning: The second of the two address chunks being interchanged.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$ with prefix $p$, chunks $h$ and $d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: suffix
symbols.meaning: The part of an address after the second chunk.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$ with prefix $p$, chunks $h$ and $d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: digit radix
symbols.meaning: The fixed prime that is the radix of the digits.
symbols.quote: Digits are radix $q$, a fixed prime.

symbols.name: chunk digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-q digits in a chunk.
symbols.quote: Let each chunk have $e=m^k$ digits, where $k$ counts recursion levels.

symbols.name: recursion levels
symbols.meaning: The number of recursion levels, with e = m^k.
symbols.quote: Let each chunk have $e=m^k$ digits, where $k$ counts recursion levels.

symbols.name: vertex matrix
symbols.meaning: The rational m by m matrix carried by a terminal or gate of the network.
symbols.quote: The [Linear exchange network with restored scratch wires](exchange-network.md) has $W$ wires; each terminal and gate carries a rational $m\times m$ matrix $M$, and edge $i$ carries $A_i=M_{\mathrm{head}(i)}-M_{\mathrm{tail}(i)}$, with $s=\sum_i\operatorname{rank}A_i$.

symbols.name: edge matrix
symbols.meaning: The difference of the matrices at the head and tail of edge i.
symbols.quote: The [Linear exchange network with restored scratch wires](exchange-network.md) has $W$ wires; each terminal and gate carries a rational $m\times m$ matrix $M$, and edge $i$ carries $A_i=M_{\mathrm{head}(i)}-M_{\mathrm{tail}(i)}$, with $s=\sum_i\operatorname{rank}A_i$.

symbols.name: edge index
symbols.meaning: The index of an edge of the network.
symbols.quote: The [Linear exchange network with restored scratch wires](exchange-network.md) has $W$ wires; each terminal and gate carries a rational $m\times m$ matrix $M$, and edge $i$ carries $A_i=M_{\mathrm{head}(i)}-M_{\mathrm{tail}(i)}$, with $s=\sum_i\operatorname{rank}A_i$.

symbols.name: wire index
symbols.meaning: The index of an input wire of the network.
symbols.quote: The shear contract: input wire $w$ is routed to an output role $\rho(w)$ with $M_{\mathrm{out}(\rho(w))}-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}=I_m$, the identity, and $s<Wm$ by [Nested subspace labels and rank deficit](subspace-labels.md).

symbols.name: role map
symbols.meaning: The map sending input wire w to its output role.
symbols.quote: The shear contract: input wire $w$ is routed to an output role $\rho(w)$ with $M_{\mathrm{out}(\rho(w))}-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}=I_m$, the identity, and $s<Wm$ by [Nested subspace labels and rank deficit](subspace-labels.md).

symbols.name: identity
symbols.meaning: The m by m identity matrix.
symbols.quote: The shear contract: input wire $w$ is routed to an output role $\rho(w)$ with $M_{\mathrm{out}(\rho(w))}-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}=I_m$, the identity, and $s<Wm$ by [Nested subspace labels and rank deficit](subspace-labels.md).

symbols.name: address shear
symbols.meaning: The array permutation moving the entry at address (H,D) to (H+MD,D).
symbols.quote: Let $\Phi_M$ move the entry at address $(H,D)$ to $(H+MD,D)$; then $\Phi_{M'}\Phi_M=\Phi_{M'+M}$.

symbols.name: wire input
symbols.meaning: The physical input array of wire w.
symbols.quote: Read wire $w$'s input $f_w$ as the logical array $\Phi_{-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}}f_w$.

symbols.name: stream row
symbols.meaning: The row number within a role stream.
symbols.quote: Within each prefix, [Elementary stream operations](stream-ops.md) split rows into role streams: row $Wx+w-1$ goes to stream $w$ as row $x$.
